newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian premier signs 1997 IMF - agreed programme.
newsitem.headline: Russian premier signs 1997 IMF - agreed programme.

text.p: Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin signed on Wednesday the government-central bank 1997 joint economic programme which has been agreed with the International Monetary Fund, Central Bank First Deputy Chairman Sergei Aleksashenko said.

Chernomyrdin's signature, following that of Central Bank Chairman Sergei Dubinin on Tuesday, is one of the key conditions for the IMF to make disbursements to Russia this year under its three-year $10 billion Extended Finance Facility loan.
